summary: Master Pension Governance and Fiduciary Responsibility with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with essential knowledge for effective management.
lede: Pension governance is the framework trustees and scheme sponsors use to oversee retirement benefits and make accountable decisions. For trustees, board members, sponsors and pension professionals, this course develops practical skills for reviewing scheme decisions in members’ best interests. You’ll learn to shape governance structures, assess funding and investment information, manage conflicts and service providers, and document decisions clearly.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who oversee or influence pension scheme governance and retirement benefit decisions.
audience: Pension fund trustees and board members
Pension scheme sponsors and finance directors
Fund administrators and pension scheme executives
Investment committee members and asset owner representatives
Risk, compliance, and internal audit professionals
modules: Foundations of Pension Governance and Fiduciary Duty
Governance Structures, Policies, and Decision Making
Understanding Pension Funding, Actuarial Valuations, and Liabilities
Investment Governance and Oversight of Pension Assets
Service Provider Management and Outsourcing Oversight
Conflicts of Interest, Ethics, and Trustee Conduct
Risk Management, Internal Controls, and Compliance
Board Dynamics, Culture, and Effective Meetings
Regulatory Interaction, Documentation, and Readiness for Review
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of pension schemes and some experience in governance or management roles related to pensions.
